remarks: Near Downtown Greenwich- This spacious end-unit has high ceilings, lots of storage and a flexible floor plan. Seller has made various updates; and the home is well maintained. The primary suite has a sitting area w/ fireplace and a large walk-in closet. There is a second floor w/d. The kitchen opens to an informal eat-in area; and family room with another fire place. The dining area has coffered ceilings and opens to the living room. Sound system/speakers are throughout. A private, outside terrace is accessed from the kitchen through french doors - easy for outside grilling! The 3/4 lower level offers storage and other options. There's an attached garage plus additional parking. Close to restaurants, train, shopping and a recently rebuilt magnet, elementary school.
